prompt:
Create a polished CHARACTER DESIGN REFERENCE SHEET of the existing European rabbit game character, based on attached references. This is a STATIC DESIGN/TURNAROUND BOARD, not an animation atlas. Reference1 locks identity, proportions, palette and style; reference2 confirms rounded rear head and centered short tail. Preserve warm muted taupe/light brown fur, ivory cheeks/muzzle/chest/paw tips, soft pink ear interiors, brown eyes, small pink-brown rabbit nose, friendly closed mouth. Very long upright rabbit ears, round soft head, rabbit cheeks and short rabbit muzzle: NEVER a cat face, triangle cat ears or long cat tail. Clean dark brown outlines and simple consistent cel shading, readable SD game style matching reference, no pixel art, no clothes/accessories.
Layout: warm ivory background, airy professional landscape board, subtle separators, title at top EXACT Korean text "유럽토끼 · 캐릭터 디자인 시트". Main upper row FOUR equally scaled fullbody relaxed standing turnarounds, aligned ground line and ear height: FRONT; FRONT-RIGHT THREE-QUARTER both eyes visible; TRUE RIGHT SIDE profile with rabbit forehead/nose/cheek silhouette; BACK with rounded head shape and two ear backs. Each has exactly2 arms/2 legs connected correctly, hands down relaxed and both feet planted naturally. Below drawings small Korean labels "정면", "사선", "측면", "뒷모습". Lower region: one enlarged FRONT FACE-ONLY PORTRAIT including both full ears, NO NECK OR CHEST below chin; two tasteful close-up callouts for short rounded tail rooted at CENTER REAR PELVIS just above buttocks (never side-waist) and rounded BACK HEELS (no toes); five colour swatches sampled from the character, do not invent different palettes. Label portrait "얼굴 초상화" and tail "중앙 꼬리 연결", heels "뒤꿈치". Keep design ratios and same base/shadow colours across all views and portrait. Feet in front/side can have subtle toe division, but BACK view heels must be plain smooth no toe/claw lines. NO paw pads, NO beans, NO coloured sole panels in any view. White feet are cream fur, not gloves or shoes. Tail small cream round puff at center of rump, not long and not attached to thigh. Whole board unobstructed, no walking poses, no arrows claiming unverified measurements, no props or scenery.
